To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the anharmonic vibrational force field of indole can be computed with a good accuracy using the B3LYPB3LYP/N07D approach, that its gas phase basicities and proton affinities have been determined with a high accuracy employing the G3 and the G4 models, and that its aqueous pKa value is -0.6 ± 0.2.

(i) the B3LY P/N07D combination is able to provide a reliable anharmonic force field for indole, and (ii) the best agreement with the experimental data is found using a combination of the G4 and the G3 methods, which is in agreement with previous results reported by us and others.

(i) the B3LYp/N07D anharmonic force field is in good agreement with the available experimental data and (ii) both the SMD and SM8 implicit models provide pK(a) values in excellent agreement with the experiment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a reliable and accurate theoretical protocol to predict the pK(a) values in water for a wide range of compounds.

the theoretical investigation of the vibrational properties of indole as a function of the level of theory and the basis set used, and of the gas phase basicity, the proton affinity, and the aqueous pKa value of indole.
the development of reliable and accurate computational schemes for the determination of the vibrational spectra, gas phase basicity, and aqueous pKa value of indole.

the B97- 1 functional is the best choice for the geometry optimization and the B3LYPP N07D is the best compromise for the vibrational analysis.

the B3LYPPN07D approach is the most suitable one to obtain the vibrational force field of indole, while the most suitable computational scheme to determine its gas phase basicities is a hybrid extrapolation scheme based on MP2 and CCSD(T) calculations.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the B3LYPPN07D approach is the best compromise for geometry optimizations and force field calculations, while the G4 model is the best choice for the determination of the gas phase basicity.

the G4 model, which has been recently developed by Curtiss and co-workers, is the method of choice for the determination of the gas phase basicity of indole and its derivatives, while the SMD model is the most reliable for the determination of their aqueous pK values.
the B97- 1/6-311+G(3df,2p) and B3LYP/N07D anharmonic force field calculations provide an excellent description of the vibrational spectra of indole.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the G4 method provides the most accurate results for the gas phase basicity, with a mean unsigned error of only 0.4 kcal/mol with respect to the experimental value.

the G4 model, which is based on the Gaussian-4 (G4) composite scheme of Curtiss and co-workers, is the most accurate method in predicting the gas phase basicity of indole, while the SMD implicit solvent model is the most accurate in computing its aqueous pKa value.
the B3LYPP/N07D combination represents a good choice to compute the force fields for the indole molecule.
